ModMetaData.name: RimTalk
ModMetaData.author: juicy
ModMetaData.description:
Ever wonder what your colonists are actually talking about when they chat around the campfire or pass each other in the hallway?
RimTalk replaces repetitive preset interactions with real conversations. Every chat is generated dynamically, shaped by each colonist's personality, mood, current thoughts, and whatever chaos is happening around the colony.
A grumpy brawler complaining about eating without a table, a tired cook bragging about a simple meal, or a sarcastic doctor checking in on a patient, colonists talk with distinct voices that reflect who they are and what they're experiencing.
Features: - Context-aware dialogue that reacts to jobs, health, thoughts, and surroundings - Distinct, customizable personalities for every colonist - Multi-language support so pawns can chat in any language - Runs asynchronously in the background without blocking game ticks - Works with Gemini, Player2, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, and local models (Ollama, LM Studio)
